decisions.reason: A 2018 schlager compilation CD in a shrinking CD market is likely out of print or delisted by 2022, and there has been no web presence since 2019.
An ongoing illustrated release series builds a collectable catalog identity, so the firm likely keeps adding to it or selling it.
Jazz vinyl reissues benefit from the continuing vinyl revival and stay viable as catalog items at low holding cost.
Multi-disc box sets are often limited runs, but a remaining stock can still be sold profitably to collectors.
A generic compilation CD that was only mentioned on the website has weak positioning and is a likely candidate for clearance as CD sales decline.
